entities.name: Ibn Khordadbeh

entities.summary: Abu'l-Qasim Ubaydallah ibn Abdallah ibn Khordadbeh, commonly known as Ibn Khordadbeh was a high-ranking bureaucrat and geographer of Persian descent in the Abbasid Caliphate. He is the author of the earliest surviving Arabic book of administrative geography.
